text.title: FreshDrop in Moscow: which buyers adopt the app first, August 2026
text.innovators: Foodies who try a new app within a week; 2–3% of Moscow buyers
text.early_adopters: Busy professionals who already order groceries online; accept a slot delay
text.early_majority: Families who want one fixed slot and a full list; need proof of reliability
text.late_majority: Older buyers and price-driven shoppers; need phone support and a price match
text.laggards: Store-only shoppers; not a target before 2028
text.now: 4% of Moscow households, July 2026; busy families buy first
text.beachhead: Families with two kids in new districts: they lack time and parking
text.whole_product: Pickup at home metro, 24/7 support, free returns, price matched to the store
